metadata.title: Phase-attributed provider-call telemetry from a production agent-memory system (32-day window, 2026-08-07 to 2026-09-08)
metadata.description:
External model-provider calls recorded by the telemetry table of the shared store of a self-hosted agent-memory system (nox-mem) during a 32-day calendar window, [2026-08-07T00:00Z, 2026-09-08T00:00Z) UTC: 3,544 rows, 13 columns. Recording started at 2026-08-07T10:40:06Z, so the first day covers about 13.3 hours. The rows include a post-deploy smoke test and traffic matching monitoring and probe signatures; calls that failed before their record was written, or whose record was dropped, are absent. The table is the instrument's log, not a verified census of every provider call.

Each call carries a phase label (construction, query, maintenance) adapted from the construction / retrieval / generation decomposition of arXiv:2606.06448: query corresponds to retrieval, generation is omitted because the agents' own LLM turns are not observed, and maintenance (compaction and consolidation) is added.

The dataset contains no free-text content: no prompts, no responses, no query text, no query hashes and no document content. Its text columns hold closed-vocabulary categorical values (provider, model, operation type, calling code path, phase, token source). Each row records the calling code path, the model, token counts, an estimated cost, the latency and a success flag.

As stored, construction is 3.16% of calls and 55.7% of estimated cost, query is 94.6% and 30.5%, and maintenance is 2.3% and 13.8%. Three calls account for 29.7% of all estimated cost.

Read the README's sixteen known defects before using any aggregate. Among them: most query-phase rows match a monitoring-canary or probe signature or time window (a signature match, not verified provenance); embedding token counts are estimated; prices are unverified list prices; LLM knowledge-graph extraction is absent from the window; there is a 13-day stretch with no construction; and the series spans a host migration. Rule-based row annotations are provided separately, and the raw table is left untouched. A verification script that recomputes the README's row-derived numbers from the CSV is included.

The telemetry covers the shared store only, not the per-agent stores.
